invariants: The selected artifact names a stage present in RunSpec.stages.
An unbenchmarked RunSpec may select any artifact name for later plan relationship verification.
A benchmarked RunSpec selects only the model artifact.
Plan relationship verification requires the selected output on its selected stage and requires a training-stage producer for a benchmarked run.
The RunSpec JSON Schema describes the two selection roles of the estimator field.
